description: You are the Security Director at ACME Corp. Company policy limits contractor on-site access to a maximum of 2 hours (120 minutes). Review the visitor management records for December 2025 and identify all contractors who violated this policy by staying on-site for strictly more than 2 hours. Export a compliance audit report of these overstay violations to /home/ga/Desktop/contractor_overstay_dec2025.csv. The report must include visitor name, company, sign-in time, sign-out time, and stay duration for each violating contractor.
